phase_policies.applies_when: Around 3 minutes, you have an unknown army posture, while the opponent has a Queen and light tech.
phase_policies.live_check: Re-evaluate if the opponent shows signs of aggression or tech progression.
phase_policies.routing_summary: Prioritize tech and economy, keep production moderate, maintain defense, and adapt if enemy aggression is detected.
phase_policies.target: Increase production and economy, while maintaining defense and continuing tech development.
phase_policies.title: Early Game Tech Development
phase_policies.veto: Do not overcommit to army production before your heavy tech investment pays off, delaying your economy and tech progression.

phase_policies.applies_when: At around 4 minutes, you have a ground-oriented posture with moderate production and heavy tech, while the opponent appears to be on a ground macro path with light or uncertain air.
phase_policies.live_check: Re-evaluate if the opponent shows signs of a tech switch or heavy air presence, or if you face early pressure that requires defensive adjustments.
phase_policies.routing_summary: Strengthen ground forces, expand economy, keep defense solid, and adjust if enemy tech or aggression changes.
phase_policies.target: Continue strengthening your ground army while increasing economy and expansions. Maintain current defense and air posture.
phase_policies.title: Early Midgame Ground Development
phase_policies.veto: Do not neglect defense or overextend expansions without scouting for early pressure or tech switches.

phase_policies.applies_when: Around 8 minutes, you have a heavy ground army with Ghosts, Hellions, and Medivacs, while the opponent has a heavy ground composition with Zerglings, Roaches, and Queens.
phase_policies.live_check: Re-evaluate if the opponent commits to a specific tech path or if you face a timing attack.
phase_policies.routing_summary: Balance ground strength with air and tech, expand economy, and stay alert to enemy tech commitments.
phase_policies.target: Increase your air presence and technology while continuing to strengthen your ground army. Maintain defense and increase economy and expansions.
phase_policies.title: Midgame Ground Army Strengthening
phase_policies.veto: Do not overcommit to ground-only forces without anti-air, leaving you vulnerable to Mutalisk harassment.

phase_policies.applies_when: Around 10 minutes, you have Siege Tanks, Marines, Medivacs, and Battlecruisers, while the opponent has Zerglings, Mutalisks, and Queens.
phase_policies.live_check: Re-evaluate if the opponent commits to a specific tech path or if you face a large engagement.
phase_policies.routing_summary: Keep a balanced ground-air composition, boost economy, and adapt to enemy tech or engagement threats.
phase_policies.target: Maintain your current army composition and defense, while increasing economy. Continue tech development.
phase_policies.title: Late Midgame Ground and Air Mix
phase_policies.veto: Do not neglect anti-air or overcommit to a single ground path without air support, leaving you vulnerable to Mutalisks.

experiment_feedback.use_boundary: Prioritize execution risks only; never infer the strategic target from agent outcomes.
